name: Sev Puri
steps: Use ready-made vegetarian, eggless shells or papdi and chutneys; check their ingredient labels for allergens and exclusions.
Dice the potato and finely chop onion. Arrange papdi in a single layer on four plates.
Set out both chutneys in separate bowls so you can control sweetness and heat.
Top each papdi with potato and onion, drizzle both chutneys and finish with sev.
Sprinkle evenly with chaat masala and chopped coriander. Start with less masala and taste before adding more.
Serve immediately before the crisp base softens. Keep extra dry components separate from chutneys and curd.
tips: Prepare components ahead, but combine wet dressings and crisp ingredients just before serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
